أتفاهم (form VI)
# أَتَفَاهَمُ (ʔatafāhamu) /ʔa.ta.faː.ha.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَفَاهَمَ (tafāhama)
# أَتَفَاهَمَ (ʔatafāhama) /ʔa.ta.faː.ha.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَفَاهَمَ (tafāhama)
# أَتَفَاهَمْ (ʔatafāham) /ʔa.ta.faː.ham/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَفَاهَمَ (tafāhama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
